purpose: This table provides a clean, deduplicated reference mapping of two-letter airline carrier codes to their full legal airline names, intended to feed joins against flight or ticketing fact tables keyed by carrier code.
usage: Consumers should join on the 'carrier' grain key to enrich flight records with human-readable airline names; both columns are fully populated (null_rate 0.0) and require no null handling.
limitations: The source profile covers only 16 rows representing a fixed reference set of carrier codes as of the extraction snapshot (2026-09-02); no duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0), and all pipeline metadata columns were excluded as they carried no business value.
